constraints: Paths beginning with src/ in diagnostics refer to skill/scripts/src/. Each named public function below is an independent callable entry after its module has initialized. The index re-exports the API functions and selected utilities; its help check does not dispatch to any callable entry.

Context keys entry.<function>.<parameter> designate the caller's actual argument slots. An omitted optional slot is distinct from an explicit null. Call instructions summarize the specified invocation at that site; later instructions on that path run only on normal completion unless a separate exceptional edge is shown. Awaited calls can reject, and synchronous calls can throw. A failure propagates through callers that do not catch it; completed requests and writes can remain.

Client and storage calls use the ambient bindings at the time each operation reads them. The three caches are separate module bindings, initially null. A cache hit returns the existing handle with creation-time credential provenance. Request property, request site URL, default range and save-time settings are separate reads where the source makes them; they need not be aliases of the settings used to create a handle.

The documented setup is npm install in scripts, a project-root .env, the three Google APIs enabled, and service-account access to GA4 and Search Console (skill/SKILL.md:8–26). The setup script changes to its own directory before npm install (skill/scripts/setup.sh:1–2). The package is ga4-toolkit 1.0.0, ESM, Node >=18; TypeScript targets ES2022 with NodeNext (skill/scripts/package.json:1–17; skill/scripts/tsconfig.json:2–19).

The Skill's workflow is an obligation: analyze, save timestamped JSON, then read the saved JSON and create Markdown in results/summaries/ with tables, trends and recommendations (skill/SKILL.md:53–64,116–142). Runtime edges below model the supplied implementation. A documented obligation is not an implemented continuation.
